items.title: This bird flies thousands of miles, but its wings have a catch

items.title: Brain cells meant to protect us may be fueling cognitive decline
items.summary: Scientists have uncovered a surprising cause of age-related cognitive decline involving brain cells previously thought to be entirely beneficial. As these cells become dysfunctional, they can produce abnormal amounts of…
items.sum_en: Scientists have uncovered a surprising cause of age-related cognitive decline involving brain cells previously thought to be entirely beneficial. As these cells become dysfunctional, they can produce abnormal amounts of myelin, disrupting nerve fibers and potentially contributing to worsening memory and thinking skills.

items.title: Your cells keep a record of every workout you’ve ever done – and those gains persist even after a break from exercise
items.summary: The data do not suggest the effects of past training can substitute for present training. But there is hope that the work you put into getting in shape isn’t completely lost over time.

items.sum_en: TGSPDCL: Electricity demand is increasing day by day and creating new records under Telangana Dakshina Pradhya Vidyut Distribusha Sansthan Limited (TGSPDCL). On October 16, a peak power demand of 20,018 MW was recorded across the state at 10:41 am. On the same day, the peak demand of 12,532 MW was recorded at 12:01 PM under TGSPDCL, setting a new record. TGSPDCL is taking steps to effectively manage the supply system in accordance with the increasing electricity needs in the state. The company is focusing on reducing interruptions in power supply, continuously monitoring the performance of the distribution system and providing better services to consumers. In this context, TGSPDCL requests that electricity consumers use electricity sparingly and contribute to electricity saving.
items.sum_te: TGSPDCL: తెలంగాణ దక్షిణ ప్రాంత విద్యుత్ పంపిణీ సంస్థ లిమిటెడ్ (TGSPDCL) పరిధిలో విద్యుత్ డిమాండ్ రోజురోజుకూ పెరుగుతూ సరికొత్త రికార్డులను సృష్టిస్తోంది. అక్టోబర్ 16న రాష్ట్రవ్యాప్తంగా ఉదయం 10:41 గంటలకు 20,018 మెగావాట్ల గరిష్ట విద్యుత్ డిమాండ్ నమోదైంది. అదే రోజు TGSPDCL పరిధిలో మధ్యాహ్నం 12:01 గంటలకు 12,532 మెగావాట్ల గరిష్ట డిమాండ్ నమోదై సరికొత్త రికార్డుగా నిలిచింది. రాష్ట్రంలో పెరుగుతున్న విద్యుత్ అవసరాలకు అనుగుణంగా సరఫరా వ్యవస్థను సమర్థవంతంగా నిర్వహించేందుకు టీజీఎస్‌పీడీసీఎల్ చర్యలు చేపడుతోంది. విద్యుత్ సరఫరాలో అంతరాయాలను తగ్గించడం, పంపిణీ వ్యవస్థ పనితీరును నిరంతరం పర్యవేక్షించడం, వినియోగదారులకు మెరుగైన సేవలు అందించడంపై సంస్థ ప్రత్యేక దృష్టి సారిస్తోంది. ఈ నేపథ్యంలో విద్యుత్ వినియోగదారులు విద్యుత్‌ను పొదుపుగా వినియోగిస్తూ, విద్యుత్ ఆదాకు సహకరించాలని టీజీఎస్‌పీడీసీఎల్ కోరుతోంది.

items.sum_en: Hyderabad: West Indies captain Shai Hope impressed with his amazing batting in the fourth T20 international match against India in Hyderabad. Along with his unbeaten 102 off 50 balls, Muthoot received the Fincorp Golden Player of the Match award. West Indies won the match by 24 runs and leveled the five-match series 2-2 at the Rajiv Gandhi International Cricket Stadium. Hope hit four fours and nine sixes in his innings. He scored 102 runs with a strike rate of 204 off 50 balls and played a key role in the West Indies team's huge score of 247 runs for the loss of three wickets in 20 overs. India were limited to 223 runs in chasing down the target.

items.sum_en: Continuing GNN’s coverage of youth nonprofit leaders, the Pedal Forward Foundation in Georgia has distributed hundreds of bicycles to low income families, and taught hundreds of children how to ride them. It’s founder, Jonathan Thai, was inspired to step up and serve his community after the local REI closed down a community bike-riding workshop. In a study involving guinea fowl, researchers discovered that birds accustomed to carrying weights while growing up could carry those weights as adults without using extra energy, while untrained birds burned 23% more.

items.title: Scientists may have finally solved the mystery of the Moon’s two faces
items.summary: Scientists may have solved a long-standing mystery about why the Moon’s two sides are so different, using samples collected from its farside for the first time. Their findings suggest that uneven heating from Earth's…
items.sum_en: Scientists may have solved a long-standing mystery about why the Moon’s two sides are so different, using samples collected from its farside for the first time. Their findings suggest that uneven heating from Earth's gravitational pull drove enormous flows of ancient magma, creating the dramatically different lunar landscapes we see today.

items.sum_en: A 165-million-year-old fossil has revealed an extraordinary Jurassic predator that may help explain how mammals developed one of their most important evolutionary advantages. items.sum_en: A softball diamond in Montana was the scene of a larger-than-life family reunion. Like something out of Field of Dreams, a teen softball player had lined up against an out-of-state team for an August match—and her long-lost biological sister was on the opposite roster. Samantha Rensvold was adopted as an infant. Rensvold had not seen the opposing player—18-year-old Kyann Dean—whom a teammate came over to explain looked exactly like her.

items.sum_en: An open-source app has thousands of Berliners adopting and watering city trees as if they were their pets, helping keep the city green amid repeated summer heatwaves. In green-minded Europe, trees are increasingly being seen as vital urban infrastructure rather than simple tools for beautification.
